evidence.title: GitHub - ChangoMan/nextjs-mdx-blog: UPDATED to Next.js App Router! Starter template built with Contentlayer, MDX, shadcn-ui, and Tailwind CSS. · GitHub

name: NextJS - MDX - shadcn-ui - Tailwind - Blog
summary: Blog starter for the Next.js App Router with MDX posts through Contentlayer and shadcn/ui components.
description: A starter template for a blog or personal site built on the Next.js App Router. Posts are written as MDX files in a posts directory and processed with Contentlayer; the UI uses shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS. Sitemap and site constants are included for taking the site live.
contains: posts written in MDX in a posts directory
shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS
sitemap and site constants for deployment
